marketing_description: The Makita® GSL02M1 double bevel sliding miter saw offers an 8-1/2 in blade and 5/8 in arbor for precise cuts. Powered by a 40 V brushless motor that reaches 4800 RPM, it features automatic torque drive technology, an electric brake, and a soft start for smooth operation. Its double bevel sliding design supports versatile cutting applications.
